reference: existing Garden Design placement shown by owner on the real saved Garden photo

observation.rootCause: Wide-canopy tree is width-constrained by narrow QA cards before the intended height band is reached.
observation.preferredPresentation: Review on the original Garden photo aspect ratio / full-width scene, not five narrow columns.

policyLearning: QA scale must be evaluated against the original photo aspect ratio.
For wide-canopy forms, width and height constraints must be evaluated together using the visible alpha bbox aspect ratio.
A nominal height band is invalid if a narrow review card causes width to become the active limiter.
Mature tree review should use a full-aspect scene with selectable scale, not multi-column thumbnails.
